architecture_contract: one Gen13 root experiment / one Gen8 physical Capsule owner + sequential delegated evaluator mutation/evaluation children over copied evaluator/fixtures

checks.expectation: Mutation specifications are typed, canonical, deterministic, and reject unknown/ambiguous fields.
checks.name: mutation_spec_schema

checks.expectation: Equivalent semantic mutation specs produce identical mutation IDs; meaningful spec/evaluator/evidence changes change identity.
checks.name: content_addressed_mutation_identity

checks.expectation: Evaluator source lineage is bound by path + SHA256 and mismatches fail closed.
checks.name: evaluator_lineage_pinned

checks.expectation: All ten declared safe evaluator mutation classes are represented and validated.
checks.name: safe_mutation_classes_complete

checks.expectation: Mutations can target only copied evaluator/fixture material under the delegated nursery workspace.
checks.name: mutation_target_workspace_only

checks.expectation: Each mutating nursery run uses Gen13 with exactly one physical Gen8 Capsule owner.
checks.name: gen13_single_physical_owner

checks.expectation: Nursery child authority and mutation scope are strict subsets of the parent context.
checks.name: authority_scope_monotonic

checks.expectation: Baseline and mutant evaluator execute against the same pinned candidate/evidence case bindings.
checks.name: baseline_mutant_same_cases

checks.expectation: Result contains baseline -> mutant -> independent oracle comparison per case.
checks.name: baseline_mutant_candidate_comparison

checks.expectation: Every attempted mutation is explicitly classified KILLED, SURVIVED_REDUNDANT_OR_EQUIVALENT, SURVIVED_DANGEROUS, or INVALID_FAIL_CLOSED.
checks.name: mutation_kill_survival_classification

checks.expectation: Threshold weakening/strengthening mutation is deterministic and bounded.
checks.name: threshold_change_supported

checks.expectation: Assertion/check deletion mutation is deterministic and bounded.
checks.name: assertion_delete_supported

checks.expectation: Assertion/check inversion mutation is deterministic and bounded.
checks.name: assertion_invert_supported

checks.expectation: Fixture substitution mutation is deterministic and evidence-bound.
checks.name: fixture_substitution_supported

checks.expectation: Evidence omission mutation is deterministic and evidence-bound.
checks.name: evidence_omission_supported

checks.expectation: Stale-evidence injection mutation is deterministic and cannot escape declared fixtures.
checks.name: stale_evidence_injection_supported

checks.expectation: Declared-vs-observed-state trust mutation is represented and challengeable.
checks.name: declared_vs_observed_trust_supported

checks.expectation: Scoring-weight mutation is deterministic and critical failures cannot be hidden by aggregate score alone.
checks.name: scoring_weight_change_supported

checks.expectation: Fail-open/fail-closed mutation is deterministic and critical fail-open behavior is detectable.
checks.name: fail_open_fail_closed_supported

checks.expectation: Negative-control corruption mutation is deterministic and inconsistency is detectable.
checks.name: negative_control_corruption_supported

checks.expectation: Evaluator mutation outside delegated scope fails closed before accepted-state mutation.
checks.name: outside_delegated_scope_rejected

checks.expectation: Mutant/evaluator child cannot expand authority beyond parent.
checks.name: authority_expansion_rejected

checks.expectation: Forged parent/delegation context is rejected.
checks.name: forged_parent_context_rejected

checks.expectation: Stale owner/evidence context binding is rejected.
checks.name: stale_context_binding_rejected

checks.expectation: Mutant cannot create an independent same-boundary Capsule under an active owner.
checks.name: independent_nested_capsule_rejected

checks.expectation: Mutation that disables or skips its own detection is rejected or classified dangerous.
checks.name: self_detection_disable_detected

checks.expectation: Malformed evaluator result fails closed.
checks.name: malformed_evaluator_result_fail_closed

checks.expectation: Evaluator crash fails closed with provenance.
checks.name: evaluator_crash_fail_closed

checks.expectation: Evaluator timeout fails closed and descendants are cleaned.
checks.name: evaluator_timeout_fail_closed

checks.expectation: Evaluator lying about which checks ran is detected from protocol/evidence mismatch.
checks.name: lying_checks_run_detected

checks.expectation: Fixture mutation outside declared evidence binding is rejected.
checks.name: fixture_outside_declared_evidence_rejected

checks.expectation: Mutation attempting accepted/current state writes is rejected/contained and accepted state remains unchanged.
checks.name: accepted_state_write_rejected

checks.expectation: Mutation attempting to alter frozen Gen14 gold is rejected and gold SHA remains unchanged.
checks.name: frozen_gold_write_rejected

checks.expectation: Benchmark/evaluator claiming PASS with skipped required checks fails closed.
checks.name: pass_with_skipped_checks_rejected

checks.expectation: Scoring mutation cannot hide an independently observed critical failure.
checks.name: critical_failure_not_hidden_by_score

checks.expectation: Nursery is used against at least one real Gen8–Gen13 evaluator with pinned lineage.
checks.name: real_prior_evaluator_self_use

checks.expectation: At least one mutation of a real prior-generation evaluator is killed by independent cases.
checks.name: self_use_kills_real_mutation

checks.expectation: Final designated dangerous suite has zero unexplained surviving dangerous mutations.
checks.name: dangerous_survivors_zero_or_resolved

checks.expectation: Overall mutation kill rate meets frozen minimum and dangerous kill rate is complete.
checks.name: mutation_kill_rate_threshold

checks.expectation: Report includes kill rates, surviving dangerous mutations, class breakdown, and invalid/protocol failures.
checks.name: detection_power_report

checks.expectation: Unique check contribution is computed where practical from isolated check mutations.
checks.name: unique_check_contribution_report

checks.expectation: Potential redundant/equivalent checks are reported separately from dangerous survivors.
checks.name: redundant_check_report

checks.expectation: Equivalent nursery runs have identical semantic mutation/result identities despite different physical Capsule runs.
checks.name: deterministic_semantic_rerun

checks.expectation: Nursery never writes accepted evaluator source or automatically promotes evaluator changes.
checks.name: no_automatic_promotion

checks.expectation: Gen13 retained benchmark remains exactly 37/37.
checks.name: gen13_retained_37_37

checks.expectation: Full Gen2–Gen12 retained regression matrix passes using established mutation-safe/version-pinned strategies.
checks.name: gen2_gen12_retained_matrix

checks.expectation: Protected-state comparison shows zero forbidden accepted-state mutations; only allowed append-only audit growth may differ.
checks.name: protected_state_preserved

checks.expectation: Guest containment remains intact: host repo/control sockets unavailable and protected private targets blocked.
checks.name: containment_preserved

checks.expectation: Operational Lab permanent MCP surface remains exactly 10 tools; no Gen14 tool growth.
checks.name: permanent_tool_surface_10

checks.expectation: Operational Gen6 server, LKG SHA, build identity, service and recovery ACCEPTED remain unchanged.
checks.name: operational_gen6_unchanged

checks.expectation: Final Architectural Twin is rebuilt after Gen14 evidence and verifies with zero issues at checkpoint.
checks.name: final_twin_fresh_zero_issues

checks.expectation: Canonical project tests pass.
checks.name: canonical_project_tests

checks.expectation: All canonical Python sources pass mutation-free AST/compile validation.
checks.name: mutation_free_python_syntax

checks.expectation: All canonical JSON/JSONL artifacts validate.
checks.name: json_jsonl_validation

checks.expectation: Gen14-owned canonical files pass high-confidence secret/credential scan.
checks.name: high_confidence_secret_scan

checks.expectation: git diff --check and new-file whitespace/final-newline checks pass without modifying unrelated work.
checks.name: git_diff_check

checks.expectation: No temporary Gen14 Capsule/process/service/archive/transfer debris remains after final cleanup.
checks.name: no_temp_process_service_archive_debris
